newsitem.title: USA: OMNICARE INC TO JOIN S&P MIDCAP 400.
newsitem.headline: OMNICARE INC TO JOIN S&P MIDCAP 400.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Wednesday that Omnicare Inc will replace Value Health Inc in the S&P MicCap Index after the close of trading on August 7, 1997.
Omnicare will be replaced in the S&P SmallCap 600 Index by Renal Care Group Inc, Standard & Poor's said in a statement.

Also, the accelerated closing of the merger between MESA Inc and Parker & Parsley Petroleum will change the S&P MidCap 400 with the addition of the resulting company, Pioneer Natural Resources Co, after the close of trading August 7.
Trading in Parker & Parsley and MESA shares will be suspended prior to the opening of trading on Friday, Standard & Poor's said.
Previously the addition of Pioneer was expected on August 8, 1997, Standard & Poor's said.
Innovex Inc will replace MESA in the S&P SmallCap 600, Standard & Poor's said.
Value Health is being acquired by Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp.
